caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug positioned centrally on a plain, light background. The jug is gray in color with a short, wide neck, an outwardly curved spout, and a rounded body that tapers toward the base. There is a large, sturdy handle attached from the top of the neck to the upper side of the body. Decorative blue painted marks, including abstract lines and flattened oval shapes, embellish various areas around the neck, handle, and body of the jug. The interior of the jug is rendered in a tan or beige shade, suggesting the inside surface of the ceramic. On the body of the jug, near the center, the inscription “R.C.B.” and the word “PARIS” beneath it are visible. The drawing is signed “Fumagalli” in the lower right corner.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
